capabilities: Open, edit and save .csv files as tables inside Obsidian
Assign field types such as number, currency, date, checkbox, link and image
Filter, group, sort rows and adjust row height and column width
Preview and visually edit .html/.htm files with a toggle to source view
Index Obsidian internal links and preview local images
extras: README includes a privacy section (fully offline, no telemetry) and warns that HTML preview runs the page's own scripts in an isolated sandbox; untrusted HTML should be viewed in source mode first. Licensed 0BSD.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to edit CSV files as structured tables or to preview and edit HTML files stored in the vault.
summary: CSV and HTML editor that opens .csv files as structured tables with typed fields and previews or edits .html files with a sandboxed preview.
